gameName: Kutná Hora: The City of Silver

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Kutná Hora: The City of Silver rules (Czech Games Edition)

modules.name: Event cards
modules.note: Required at 2 players; optional at 3-4 for a livelier economy.

steps.text: Rounds track on its {side} side; rounds counter on space 1, tax counter on 0
Stack the 3 red-patrician buildings on the marked square of the rounds track
Guild buildings: 6 colour stacks; shuffle the 6 marked-corner tiles onto the 2 left columns, the other 3 of each colour on top in random order
Green, silver and yellow patrician buildings: shuffle each colour, stack at the end of its row
Kutná Hora board on its {side} side
Draw a random mine setup card; rock tiles facedown on its spaces, then flip them
Card stands with arms far left; population 0-19 and ore 0-14 in order, 0 in front, turn-over card at the back
St. Barbara's Cathedral: tiles 1-5 bottom, 6-10 middle, 11 on top
Bank: coins, pelican tokens and exactly 3 patrician tokens of each colour
4 mining technology tiles facedown in order, 1 on top
Mine tiles: shuffle by back; stack I on top, II, III at the bottom, on the prospecting board
Shuffle event decks A and B; deal 1 facedown above each round except the last: A before the red-patrician stack, B after
Reveal the round 1 event; a tax symbol on it raises the tax counter now
Player board in your colour; 3 plot markers and 12 house tokens
4 production markers at 0; 2 spare beside the board for income over 10
1 miner in your pool, the other 8 in the waiting zone
Reputation marker on 0; score counter on 0 of the Kutná Hora board
Your 6 action cards in hand (they are open information)
Starting groschen by seat: {g}
Random guild setup card (first game: card 1); in reverse seat order each player picks a set of 3 guilds
In seat order, place your guild tiles in the rows of your board
Turns 1 and 2: play 2 action cards; turn 3: play 1
Advancing a price deck: slide the front card to the back without flipping it
Refill your miner pool only as the first step of a Mine action
End of each round: pay taxes or take the reputation penalty
You can take guild buildings only for your own guilds
Starting player marker to whoever was most recently underground (or random)
